steps.name: Enter demo app
steps.goal: If the data and AI providers consent screen is shown, tap Agree and continue for this demo test account. Otherwise wait for Home.
steps.done: The app navigation button is visible.

steps.name: Open audio settings
steps.goal: Tap Navigation. Computer: Your Computer, then tap Settings.
steps.done: The production Settings screen includes the three transcription modes and language.

steps.name: Native transcription menu
steps.goal: Tap the Transcription row. Leave the menu open.
steps.done: The native picker shows all three transcription modes.

steps.name: Select Auto mode
steps.goal: The native menu is already open. Tap the Auto menu option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Transcription row again.
steps.done: The Auto mode button is selected.

steps.name: Native model ready
steps.goal: If a transcription menu is open, tap Auto to close it. Wait for the native model ready status on the Audio settings screen.
steps.done: Whistle has downloaded and loaded in the actual iOS app.

steps.name: Open picker for cloud override
steps.goal: Tap the Transcription settings row to open its native menu. Leave it open.
steps.done: All three mode choices are visible in the native menu.

steps.name: Cloud override
steps.goal: The native menu is already open. Tap the Cloud option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Transcription title.

steps.name: Open picker for local override
steps.goal: Tap the Transcription settings row to open its native menu. Leave it open.
steps.done: All three mode choices are visible in the native menu.

steps.name: Local override
steps.goal: The native menu is already open. Tap the Local option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Transcription title.
steps.done: Local transcription uses the loaded native model.

steps.name: Open picker for unsupported language
steps.goal: Tap the Language settings row to open its native menu. Leave it open.
steps.done: The native menu shows the language choices.

steps.name: Unsupported language
steps.goal: The native language menu is already open. Tap the Cantonese (cloud) option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Language title.
steps.done: Settings explains that Cantonese requires cloud.

steps.name: Open picker for restore language
steps.goal: Tap the Language settings row to open its native menu. Leave it open.
steps.done: The native menu shows the language choices.

steps.name: Restore language
steps.goal: The native language menu is already open. Tap the Auto detect option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Language title.
steps.done: The language is Auto detect and the native model is ready.

steps.name: Open picker for restore auto mode
steps.goal: Tap the Transcription settings row to open its native menu. Leave it open.
steps.done: All three mode choices are visible in the native menu.

steps.name: Restore Auto mode
steps.goal: The native menu is already open. Tap the Auto option to select it and close the menu. Do not tap the Transcription title.
steps.done: The Auto mode button is selected with the model ready.
